# IncompatibilityRule

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public record IncompatibilityRule
```

A constraint on which variants may be rolled together. Legality is a function of the variant selection alone, so it is decided before any pixel is touched — a rejected roll costs only the rolls themselves.

**Parameters**

- `When` (`RuleTarget`) - The trigger: the rule applies only when this variant was rolled.
- `Targets` (`IReadOnlyList<RuleTarget>`) - What is then forbidden or required.
